Direction A (Training lane) is the deliverable: dark, instrument-like, prescribes one session, shows the graph. Matches Phase 3 positioning.
Direction B (far right) is the calm lane for comparison, so the Sep 8 positioning decision can be made by looking.
Paywall carries every element App Review checks on-screen (Lessons Learned 3.4). Prices are the Phase 2 recommendation, not final.
